## Problem and result

Explain the concrete problem and resulting behavior.
Link the issue and its acceptance criteria.

## Changes and preserved behavior

Describe the affected documentation, build, or workflow contracts.
Identify any behavior change and confirm the scope excludes unrelated changes.

## Verification and limitations

List commands, outcomes, tested versions, and coverage.
Distinguish executed, failed, and NOTRUN checks with reasons.
Confirm relative links, examples, and rendered documentation when changing prose.

## Review and delivery

Record whole-PR review, required checks, and unresolved follow-ups before merging.
Confirm `main` readback and task-owned cleanup after merging.
